description: The Doctor actions beside the conversation, as the app does them. Record a decision only when the customer says what they did; change memory consent only when they ask. decision: GET doctor/messages/{messageId}/decision params {beforeRevision}; record_decision: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/decision {messageId, messageDigest, threadId, binding, expectedRevision, confirmation SAVE_RESPONSE, decision followed|changed|skipped|unknown, modifiedTicketId}; saved_reply: GET doctor/messages/{messageId}/saved-reply params {messageDigest, threadId, ticketId|reportId|historyKind+historyId}; grade_this: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/grade-quote app body; compare_books: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/book-prices app body; revise_ticket: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/revisions app body; book_check: GET doctor/book-comparisons/{comparisonId}; delete_thread: POST doctor/threads/{threadId}/delete (confirmation DELETE); memory_status: GET doctor/memory; memory_context: GET doctor/memory/context; memory_consent: POST doctor/memory/consent {enabled, expectedGeneration, confirmation ALLOW_HONCHO_MEMORY|DISABLE_HONCHO_MEMORY}; memory_forget_all: POST doctor/memory/forget {expectedGeneration} (confirmation FORGET_RECALLED_MEMORY); notes_consent: POST memory/consent {enabled, expectedGeneration} (on/off switch).
